{{Quote|It's quite a find. Mandalorian artefacts are extremely ''rare''. The two items discovered on the moon of Korasa appear to be ''very'' special indeed.|Plo Koon, to Shaak Ti|<ref name="Memories">{{TCWComicCite|6.41|Mandalorian Memories}}</ref>}}
'''Korasa''' was the smallest of three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

==Description==
{{Quote|The reason we forced that freighter to land on Korasa was because I needed a handful of ''moon dust''&hellip;|Boba Fett, to Bossk|<ref name="Memories" />}}
Korasa was one of three [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], which orbited a [[Star/Legends|star]] of the same [[Kamino (star)|name]]. The moon resided in the [[Kamino system/Legends|Kamino system]],<ref name="Geo" /> an [[Extragalactic/Legends|extragalactic]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the lower periphery of the [[Rishi Maze/Legends|Rishi Maze]],<ref name="Atlas" /> situated twelve [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] from it. In the moon's southern hemisphere resided [[Temperature/Legends|snow]] dunes.<ref name="Geo" />

==Behind the scenes==
Korasa was first mentioned in ''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]'', a [[2004]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Geo" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Kamino [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore Korasa itself, in grid square S-15.<ref name="Atlas" />
